tracking: ADR-0357 §4 (lane E38): the brief is API and backend only (master brief 2026-11-17, rule 3); the policy hierarchy and effective-policy screen is requested on #453

gaps.GET /v1/business-units: lists business units (the level between the org and its projects in the policy hierarchy), paginated
gaps.PATCH /v1/business-units/:businessUnitId: renames or describes a business unit (audited)
gaps.PUT /v1/projects/:projectId/business-uni: moves a project under a business unit or back under the org; a move that loosens its effective policy is a settings_relax step-up (audited)
gaps.GET /v1/governance-policy/layer: reads one level's own policy layer (org, business unit, project or use case)
gaps.PUT /v1/governance-policy/layer: writes one level's policy layer: tighten-only against its parent, compare-and-set, loosening its own previous self is a settings_relax step-up (audited)
gaps.DELETE /v1/governance-policy/layer: removes one level's policy layer (a settings_relax step-up for every rule it set, audited)
gaps.GET /v1/governance-policy/effective: the effective policy at a level, each rule with its value and the level that set it (readable by agents)
